figurative_meaning_en: A forbidden boundary or line of danger that should not be crossed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার স্ত্রীর সাথে সম্পর্কে লক্ষ্মণরেখা অতিক্রম করেছে।
এই বিষয়ে লক্ষ্মণরেখা পার হয়ে যাওয়া বিপজ্জনক।
example_sentences_in_english: He crossed the Lakshman Rekha in his relationship with his wife.
Crossing this Lakshman Rekha on the matter is dangerous.
history: Derived from the Ramayana epic, where Lakshmana draws a protective line (rekha) around the hut in the forest to safeguard Sita from danger, instructing her not to cross it; her violation leads to her abduction by Ravana.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to denote an inviolable limit.
